name: ContextForge MCP Gateway
description: A feature-rich gateway and proxy that federates MCP, REST, and gRPC services into a unified endpoint for AI clients. It enables virtualization of legacy APIs as MCP-compliant tools while providing built-in security, rate-limiting, and OpenTelemetry observability.

rawRecord.description: A feature-rich gateway and proxy that federates MCP, REST, and gRPC services into a unified endpoint for AI clients. It enables virtualization of legacy APIs as MCP-compliant tools while providing built-in security, rate-limiting, and OpenTelemetry observability.

MCP_AUTH.description: Bearer token used when running mcpgateway.wrapper (e.g., 'Bearer your-token-here').

JWT_SECRET_KEY.description: Secret key for signing JWT tokens (32+ chars). Generate with 'openssl rand -hex 32'.

MCP_SERVER_URL.description: The URL of the target MCP server for the mcpgateway.wrapper.

SECURE_COOKIES.description: Set false for HTTP (non-HTTPS) dev environments.

MCP_TOOL_CALL_TIMEOUT.description: Timeout for tool calls in seconds for the mcpgateway.wrapper.

AUTH_ENCRYPTION_SECRET.description: Passphrase for encrypting stored credentials. Generate with 'openssl rand -hex 32'.
